name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Folds sections of content under their titles, one or many open at a time.

files.content:
'use client' import * as React from 'react' import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from 'radix-ui' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' /** * Accordion, 1:1 with the uiKit `Accordion / Item` set (4025:3554): sections under a * border/subtle rule, 4px top and bottom. The header is a 40px row, 8px in, radius-lg, with an * optional 16px lead icon (text/muted), the 14px medium title and a 16px chevron, 12px apart; * hover fills it bg/hover, keyboard focus adds the 2px focus ring. Open, the chevron turns up * and the content follows in 14px text/muted, 4 / 8 / 12 / 8 in, lined up with the title. * * Built on the Radix Accordion: the header is a button with aria-expanded, Enter or Space * toggles it, arrow keys move between headers. `type="single"` keeps one section open * (`collapsible` lets it close too); `type="multiple"` opens any number. * * Opening, the header stays put and the section grows downwards to its content's height over * 250 ms on the kit's ease-out, while the content settles from 98% scale (from its top edge) and * 92% opacity to full; closing runs the same way back in 200 ms. */ export type AccordionProps = React.ComponentProps export function Accordion({ className, ...props }: AccordionProps) { return } export interface AccordionItemProps extends Omit, 'title'> { title: React.ReactNode /** A 16px icon before the title. */ icon?: React.ReactNode /** Show a state without interacting, for state sheets. */ 'data-force'?: 'hover' | 'focus' } export function AccordionItem({ title, icon, children, className, 'data-force': force, ...props }: AccordionItemProps) { return ( {icon && ( {icon} )} {title}
{children}
) }
